When enabled, visitors without a XenForo account can vote by entering their Minecraft username. Repeat-vote checks for guests use a secure IP hash and Minecraft username.

Enable only for local development and trusted network testing. When enabled, Minecraft status queries may target private addresses such as 127.0.0.1, localhost, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x and 192.168.x.x. Keep disabled in production.
When enabled, /minecraft-vote-api/ exposes public status, player, vote and ranking data for active servers as JSON. IP-based rate limiting applies.
When enabled, guests and users entering a username manually cannot vote. The user must select a verified Minecraft account linked to their XenForo account.
Three-letter ISO currency code for sponsor packages. Example: TRY, EUR, USD.
Price of the 30-day sponsor package. 0 or an invalid value removes the package from sale.
Price of the 7-day sponsor package. 0 or an invalid value removes the package from sale.
When enabled, owners of active servers can purchase 7- or 30-day sponsored listings through XenForo payment profiles.
When enabled, the vote form uses the CAPTCHA provider configured in XenForo. It may be disabled for local testing if necessary.
Time that must pass before a player can vote for the same server again. The default is 24 hours.
Determines how many times the queue retries a failed NuVotifier delivery. Retries use increasing delays.
When enabled, new votes are sent to an HTTPS webhook address by a background job. Redirects are disabled and private/reserved network targets are blocked unless local-test access is enabled.
